text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, tramadol hydrochloride 50 mg tablets are not on FDA's drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 303 tablets (16.7 days on hand at 18.1 tablets/day). Corvale General holds 532 tablets (29 days on hand at 18.4 tablets/day).

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include tramadol hydrochloride as of 2026-10-21. The current label names A-S Medication Solutions as the registered plant. That plant received a VAI classification on 2026-08-12, a Warning Letter on 2017-06-05, and multiple prior VAI inspections dating back to 2009. The rule-based alternate manufacturer ranked first is Advagen Pharma Limited, which is not on FDA's shortage list and uses Rubicon Research Limited, last inspected NAI on 2024-03-08.

Our position: Current inventory provides limited coverage at Corvale East and moderate coverage at Corvale General. The primary manufacturer's plant has a history of regulatory findings. Alternate manufacturers are not on FDA's shortage list.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer verifies current inventory against the days-on-hand figures and confirms Advagen Pharma Limited supply availability before placing orders. (Approved by: Pharmacy Director)
2. Buyer evaluates Advagen Pharma Limited as the primary alternate source based on its plant's NAI inspection status. (Approved by: Pharmacy Director)
3. Buyer qualifies Aurobindo Pharma Limited as a secondary alternate source, noting its plant's VAI inspection on 2022-05-10. (Approved by: Pharmacy Director)
4. Buyer requests plant identification for Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC, Advanced Rx of Tennessee, LLC, and Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC to complete supplier assessment. (Approved by: Pharmacy Director)
5. Buyer updates the committee on procurement status at the next P&T meeting. (Approved by: P&T Committee Chair)

Not recommended: No changes to formulary status or clinical protocols based solely on this supply assessment.
